description: Defines a template class ClampedNumeric for numeric types with saturation arithmetic, including operator overloads, type conversions, and math operations. Implements clamped math utilities within the base::internal namespace.

classes.name: ClampedNumeric
classes.description: A template class for numeric types with saturation arithmetic, supporting various operators and conversions.

methods.name: operator+=
methods.description: Adds a value to the ClampedNumeric with saturation.

methods.name: operator-=
methods.description: Subtracts a value from the ClampedNumeric with saturation.

methods.name: operator*=
methods.description: Multiplies the ClampedNumeric by a value with saturation.

methods.name: operator/=
methods.description: Divides the ClampedNumeric by a value with saturation.

methods.name: Abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value with saturation.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of the current value and another, with saturation.

methods.name: Min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of the current value and another, with saturation.

methods.name: UnsignedAbs
methods.description: Returns the unsigned absolute value, handling signed min.

methods.name: MathOp
methods.description: Performs a math operation using a specified math wrapper.

methods.name: operator Dst()
methods.description: Type conversion operator to Dst type with saturation.

methods.name: RawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw underlying value without saturation.
